response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT si.healtheval, sc.scancount, sc.gbsize, sc.spanmin FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref), g AS (SELECT healtheval, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, SUM(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN gbsize END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN spanmin END), 0) AS gb_per_min FROM s GROUP BY healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM g) SELECT g.healtheval, g.total_scans, g.gb_per_min, g.gb_per_min - a.avg_gb_per_min AS excess_over_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.gb_per_min > a.avg_gb_per_min

assumptions.assumption: GB per minute for a status is total gbsize divided by total spanmin (ratio of sums), using only scans where both gbsize and spanmin are present.
The average is the unweighted mean of the per-status GB per minute values. Statuses with a missing value are ignored. If the average is missing, no rows are returned.
total scans is the sum of scancount over all matched scans in the status, ignoring null scancount. It is not limited to scans that have both gbsize and spanmin.
A null healtheval is treated as its own group, as GROUP BY does by default.

alternatives.interpretation: GB per minute for a status is the average of each scan's own gbsize/spanmin ratio, rather than the ratio of totals. Scans with a null or zero spanmin or a null gbsize are skipped.
